preconditions: an explicit borehole-unit to mapped-unit proposal exists
borehole role has been classified against the exact route
requiredEvidence: geologic age interval and time-scale identity
decisionLogic: reject any borehole that is not a GeometryConstraint for the route
compare normalized concepts and vocabulary identity separately from source wording
require overlapping geologic-age intervals expressed against the same time-scale authority and version
reject conflicting declared events above or below the proposed unit
never treat a compatible result as authorization without explicit correlation review
outputs: CompatibleCandidate or Rejected with dimension-specific reasons
uncertainty: age intervals are compared as closed intervals; no conversion across time-scale versions is attempted
exclusions: no use of RegionalContextOnly holes as geometry
no automatic correlation or subsurface continuation
validationMethod: positive multidimensional case and independent scope, vocabulary, age, event, missing-data and evidence-status rejection tests
reopenCondition: reviewed Aso mapped-unit identities, ages and on-route borehole evidence become available
